# NFL

## Cargar y unir datos - Big Data Bowl

```{python}
#| label: "cargar-datos"
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"
#| message: false


import pandas as pd
import glob
import os


train_folder = r"C:\Users\limco\Documents\Datos_\train"


supp_folder = r"C:\Users\limco\Documents\Datos_"

```



```{python}
#| label: "cargar-input"
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"
#| message: false



input_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(train_folder, "input_2023_w*.csv")))
if not input_files:
    raise FileNotFoundError("No se encontraron archivos de input en la carpeta train")

df_input = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(f) for f in input_files], ignore_index=True)
print("Inputs cargados:", len(df_input), "filas")

```



```{python}
#| label: "cargar-output"
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"
#| message: false




output_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(train_folder, "output_2023_w*.csv")))
if not output_files:
    raise FileNotFoundError("No se encontraron archivos de output en la carpeta train")

df_output = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(f) for f in output_files], ignore_index=True)
print("Outputs cargados:", len(df_output), "filas")

```



```{python}
#| label: "cargar-supplementary"
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"
#| message: false

supp_file = os.path.join(supp_folder, "supplementary_data.csv")
df_sup = pd.read_csv(supp_file, low_memory=False)

# corregir tipo
df_sup["play_action"] = df_sup["play_action"].astype("boolean")

print("Supplementary cargado:", len(df_sup), "filas")

```




```{python}
#| label: "unir-datasets"
#| echo: false
#| results: "hide"

df_merged = df_input.merge(df_sup, on=['game_id','play_id'], how='left')


df_merged = df_merged.merge(df_output, on=['game_id','play_id','nfl_id','frame_id'], how='left')

print("Dataset final:", len(df_merged), "filas")
```
